scope.purpose: Identify small source-reuse and held-pose repairs for proven phase/pose mismatch without changing gameplay semantics.

applicable_rules: DL-MOT-04: visual feedback must describe the same event as the interaction.
DL-MOT-07: static transforms or arbitrary pose changes do not establish authored character animation.
DL-MOT-08: atlas validation does not establish in-context temporal quality.
DL-MOT-09: Ballerina cells are held semantic pose keys; only the curtain call plays once and holds.
method: Viewed the original 1024x1024 Magician, Pop Star and Ballerina atlases at original resolution as 4x4 grids of 256x256 cells.
Traced shared actor setup, row selection, frame playback and Hall phase ownership in the current source.
Compared source pixels with the existing source-bound animation review, next-pose containment review and current animation-contract follow-up.
Frame mappings below describe visible still semantics only. No motion score or runtime acceptance is inferred from source sheets.

current_runtime_contract.phase_flow: A phase opens at idle. World travel requests the travel row and returns to idle. Accepted non-talk input requests a phase task pose. Completion requests cheer for a 2.2 second result hold.
current_runtime_contract.two_act_effect: The same first three phase dictionaries are repeated in practice and stage. A phase-name mapping therefore preserves the interaction, goal and input semantics across both acts.
current_runtime_contract.magician: Idle, travel, work and cheer currently use ordinary four-cell loops. Every non-talk phase receives the same row-2 loop unless a mapping is added.
current_runtime_contract.popstar: Idle, travel, work and cheer currently use ordinary four-cell loops. The work row is a coherent singing family, but it is still requested during DANCE arrow selection and ENCORE circle input.
current_runtime_contract.ballerina: Already held by controller policy for idle/travel/work, with specialist per-pose work-cell selection and a one-shot curtain call. It is the Hall control case and should not be generalized or changed by this repair.

recommended_small_fix.shape: Replace the integer-only phase table with or add a Hall-specific table whose entries name both atlas row and cell, then route through the existing show_pose(row, cell) path. Keep phase dictionaries, goals, inputs, widgets, two-act repetition and atlas pixels unchanged.

magician_phase_mapping.reason: Contained glow/wrap is the closest existing casting state. Mounted evidence must still show Lamba/hat ownership.
No cell depicts a shuffled hat. The quiet/watchful wand pose avoids repeatedly creating unrelated portals while the hat surface owns the answer.
The long yellow loop is the closest existing rope/ribbon-like effect; mounted review must reject it if it reads only as an orbit.
No work cell depicts cabinet doors or pulling. A neutral presenting pose avoids a false portal while the cabinet surface owns the action.
This cell visibly contains the large portal used by the named phase.

popstar_phase_mapping.behavior: retain ordinary work-row loop pending mounted cadence review
popstar_phase_mapping.reason: Every cell retains microphone-at-mouth singing intent; holding a single key would remove plausible existing response without evidence of a defect.
No atlas cell depicts arrow selection or a dance step. Neutral singer staging prevents the singing loop from being misreported as dance acting while the choice surface owns the response.

popstar_phase_mapping.behavior: retain ordinary work-row loop pending audio-synchronized capture
popstar_phase_mapping.reason: The sustained singing family matches listen-and-sing intent; timing and pivot stability remain unverified.
The broad singer presentation fits an encore hold but does not depict the requested full-body circle/spin. Completion may still request the existing cheer path.

recommended_small_fix.ballerina: No change. Preserve BALLERINA_POSE_FRAMES, specialist show_pose calls and DL-MOT-09 one-shot cheer behavior exactly.

lower_code_churn_option.shape: If the phase table must remain integer-only and row-2-only, add only Magician VANISH=0, ROPE=1 and PORTAL=3. Do not assign TRACK or CABINET arbitrary work cells. Add Pop Star ENCORE=3 only if mounted review accepts incidental singing during circle input.
lower_code_churn_option.limitation: This option leaves the proven Magician TRACK/CABINET generic work loop unless _play_roshan_task_pose can select a neutral idle row. It is therefore partial containment, not the preferred repair.

completion_and_shared_actor_risks: Adding Magician or Pop Star to STORY_POSE_FRAMES would also change menu idle selection, travel and cheer globally. That broad controller-level change is not justified by the phase-specific work-row evidence and should be avoided for the first repair.

The current ordinary cheer loops at 6 fps. A later one-shot/held cheer change should be reviewed separately against the bow and finish cells; copying Ballerina policy without capture could alter Hall celebration timing.

show_pose stops frame processing. A held phase must still be explicitly replaced by idle at phase arm, travel during world movement and cheer at completion; current call sites provide those transitions, but a mounted trace must verify them.
Actor bounce tweens continue independently of atlas playback. A held cell can still move as feedback and must be checked for target overlap and stable return.
Magician work-cell effects are painted into the actor cell. They can overlap or compete with the separate phase-owned hat, rope, cabinet or portal surface at the mounted 250px actor size.
Pop Star SOUND CHECK and RHYTHM may benefit from the current four-key singing family. Converting the whole career to held poses would discard plausible reuse and exceed the proven defect scope.
Practice and stage reuse phase names. Any name-based mapping applies to both acts, which is desirable only if the actor/prop composition is readable against both backdrops.
evidence_basis: audit/minigame_art_quality_2026-09-05/animation_review.md: source review identifies Magician's effect substitution, Pop Star's coherent singing family and Ballerina's held-key authority.
audit/minigame_art_quality_2026-09-05/next_pose_containment_review.json: recommends Magician work cells 0, 1 and 3 for VANISH, ROPE and PORTAL while leaving TRACK and CABINET unsupported.
tmp/opera-current-animation-contract-followup.json: records current loop ownership and the unreviewed action/contact/settle states.
design/OPERA_TWO_ACT_PERFORMANCES_2026-09-05.md: binds the three-career Hall scope and practice-to-stage phase repetition.
required_followup_evidence: Mobile 1280x720 captures for every affected phase in both practice and stage, with actor and phase-owned prop visible.
For Magician: verify Lamba/hat ownership, TRACK watch state, ROPE interpretation, cabinet relationship and portal overlap before adopting each candidate.

For Pop Star: capture a complete SOUND CHECK and RHYTHM loop with audio/gesture timestamps before retaining it as coherent motion; capture DANCE and ENCORE held candidates without calling them authored dance/spin.
Record the displayed atlas row/cell at phase open, first accepted contact, completion request and post-completion hold.
Review on the target phone for silhouette, prop competition and touch-area occlusion. Child and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance_limits: Original-sheet inspection cannot establish runtime cadence, interpolation, stable pivots, mounted scale, contact, occlusion, audio synchronization or target-device readability.
A held cell is damage containment for semantic contradiction. It is not authored anticipation/action/contact/payoff/settle animation and does not satisfy DL-MOT-07 by itself.
The proposed neutral TRACK, CABINET and DANCE cells are reuse candidates, not evidence that the actor performs those verbs.
No full-game, full-Hall, animation, visual, child, owner or release acceptance is claimed.
